column1: # The ledger of the test_weld lint (//:test_weld, tools/build/lint/test_weld.bzl): the test files
# no target welds and the packages with code that weld no test, each with its reason.
# One row each: <path> TAB <reason>. It only shrinks: the lint fails on a row whose test
# is welded, or whose package welds a test, so the change that welds it deletes the row.
